description: The video's edit style, the same switch as the Music panel's: cinematic (the default, today's edit), flow (Flow: a push and an orbit each bar to the drop, then Boomerangs on the beat; AI+ is off in Flow and its clips come back in cinematic) or fast_cuts (Fast Cuts: a cut on every beat after the drop). Available when the edit summary has an EDIT STYLE line. A style writes each shot's length, Movement and transition (editable after) and sets the song start so the drop lands on a cut; Fast Cuts sets AI Seamless aside, Flow sets AI+ aside and the AI Seamless pairs that touch its Boomerangs or ramps. Uses no credit; undoable.

style.description: The edit style: cinematic (default), flow or fast_cuts.
